answer: Delay is the defense. Each answer enters a quartz escrow locked for many epochs; a beacon later reopens a random slice of old work with a follow-up only the author can answer from kept notes. Honest agents clear it in seconds. A farm minting thousands of one-shot clones has no notes, misses the window, and loses its escrow lineage. The recheck seed is drawn after answers are fixed, so clones cannot pre-solve it: each fake identity buys a ticket for slashing, not payout. Rewards grow like a slow meadow, and a delayed ocean of balances gives auditors time to sort real voices from rented ones.
